notes.title: Game releases on August 11th
notes.content:
PSI Magic is a casual RPG Game featuring two protagonists; Abell and Ceres, who get sent to another world due to the activities of a certain otherworldly group.

Features:
- Mercenary Hall
- Hidden Bosses leading to a secret ending
- A large world to explore with items hidden and collectable
- A simple crafting and augmentation system
- Transformation abilities
- Scaling enemies
